It was my Birthday ! 
Thank you friends, that you are in my life.
text.intro:
Thank you, my friends, for always being up for my crazy adventures.
We celebrated a birthday at a campsite, went swimming in the rain, went hiking, and sat around the campfire with a guitar.
It means a lot to me, and I’m really grateful for these moments!
